detailed_description: The Color Palette tool creates related colors from a selected base HEX value. It calculates a range of lightness shades, a complementary color, analogous colors, and triadic colors using HSL conversion in the browser. Each color swatch can be copied for use in CSS, design tokens, mockups, or documentation. The tool is best for quick palette exploration. It does not evaluate accessibility contrast, brand consistency, color-blind safety, or print color profiles.
usage_steps: Pick a base color or enter a HEX value.
Check the complementary, analogous, and triadic groups.
Click a color swatch to copy its HEX value.
Paste copied colors into CSS, design tokens, or notes.
Run separate contrast checks before using colors for text.
usage_examples: Generate a light-to-dark shade scale from a brand blue.
Copy a complementary color for a call-to-action accent.
Explore analogous colors for a softer UI theme.
Use triadic colors as a starting point for charts or badges.

faqs.question: What does the Color Palette tool generate?
faqs.answer: It generates shades, complementary colors, analogous colors, and triadic colors from a base HEX color.

faqs.question: Can I copy palette colors?
faqs.answer: Yes. Click a swatch to copy its HEX value.

faqs.question: Does the page check accessibility contrast?
faqs.answer: No. Use a dedicated contrast checker before choosing text and background colors.

faqs.question: Does it support alpha transparency?
faqs.answer: No. The generated values are standard HEX colors without alpha.

faqs.question: Are these colors guaranteed to match a brand system?
faqs.answer: No. Treat them as starting points and review them against your actual brand guidelines.
